name: Webhook
description: Webhook forwarder — sends messages to n8n or any HTTP endpoint. Deduplication is controlled via global Settings.

config.name: webhookURL
config.label: Webhook URL
config.description: Destination URL to POST messages to

config.name: authToken
config.label: Authorization Token
config.description: Value for the Authorization header (n8n mode). Leave blank if not required.

config.name: mode
config.label: Webhook Mode
config.description: n8n: sends full message JSON with Authorization header. Generic: use custom headers and payload template.

config.name: genericHeaders
config.label: Custom Headers (JSON)
config.description: Generic mode only. JSON object of headers to send, e.g. {"X-Api-Key": "abc"}

config.name: genericPayloadTemplate
config.label: Payload Template
config.description: Generic mode only. Template string with {field} placeholders. Available fields: address, message, source, timestamp, alias, agency, icon, color

config.name: filterMode
config.label: Filter Mode
config.description: Filter mode to use (all messages, defined aliases, per alias only)

aliasConfig.name: enable
aliasConfig.label: Enable
aliasConfig.description: Enable sending messages that match this alias via Webhook

aliasConfig.name: webhookURL
aliasConfig.label: Override Webhook URL
aliasConfig.description: Optional. Use a different webhook URL for this alias. Leave blank to use the global URL.
